verdict.rationale: Vue's official site lists Vue Router as part of its ecosystem (vue-docs-7, alongside the ecosystem claim in vue-docs-2). Independent developers describe it as an official router (vue-comm-9) and as an officially supported library that works great with Vue out of the box (vue-comm-13), which corroborates both the first-party status and the seamless integration. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation in the pack describing how the router integrates (only a link title is present), and recent hands-on evidence for current Vue 3 versions.
